description: This file defines a caching mechanism for tracking endpoint slice distribution metrics in Kubernetes, including classes for cache management, endpoint port caching, and functions for updating and calculating desired endpoint slices.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Tracks total desired endpoints and endpoint slice distribution efficiency.

classes.name: EndpointPortCache
classes.description: Stores endpoint and slice counts for specific service port combinations.

classes.name: EfficiencyInfo
classes.description: Holds counts of endpoints and slices for calculation purposes.

methods.name: NewCache
methods.description: Creates a new Cache with specified endpoints per slice.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets efficiency info for a specific port key in EndpointPortCache.

methods.name: numEndpoints
methods.description: Returns total number of endpoints in EndpointPortCache.

methods.name: UpdateEndpointPortCache
methods.description: Updates cache with new endpoint port cache and recalculates metrics.

methods.name: DeleteEndpoints
methods.description: Removes endpoint resource from cache and updates metrics.
